card.title: IPad Wifi IC Compatibility and Replacement Guide

source.title: IPad Wifi IC Compatibility and Replacement Guide

claims.statement: Wi-Fi-only and cellular iPad boards use different Wi-Fi ICs that are not cross-compatible; the wrong one gives no Wi-Fi and no MAC.
iPad 7 (A2197), iPad 8 (A2270) and iPad 9 (A2602) Wi-Fi models use 339S00448; their cellular models (iPad 7 A2198/A2200, iPad 8 A2428/A2429/A2430, iPad 9 A2603/A2604/A2605) use 339S00445.

procedure: Check the A-number on the back housing.
Confirm the Wi-Fi IC part number in boardview.
Check rails near the Wi-Fi IC for shorts.
Replace with the exact same part number from a same-variant donor.
card.caveats: The guide also mentions iPad 10 but gives no part number for it. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
